offering_description.value: Cirrus Logic sells audio and mixed-signal chips to consumer electronics manufacturers, primarily for smartphones and computers. It designs the chips and contracts out fabrication, assembly and testing.

primary_products.value: audio codecs; audio amplifier ICs; haptic driver ICs; camera actuator controller ICs; power and battery management ICs

customer_segment.value: B2B: Smartphone, computer and other electronics OEMs and their contract manufacturers

end_markets.value: smartphones; personal computers; wearables; other consumer electronics; automotive audio

revenue_model.value: product sales: Audio and mixed-signal chips purchased for integration into electronic devices

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Designs chips, outsources production and supplies finished components to electronics OEMs and contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Asia and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Audio, haptics, camera control and power management chips share mixed-signal design technology and electronics customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house sales teams serving electronics OEMs and their contract manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Electronic component distributors serving equipment manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chip exports subject to U.S. export controls and product materials subject to EU RoHS restrictions
